Run the three “Next Commands” in order; they’re already the right next step given you have a current champion and no PASS/INCONCLUSIVE candidates.

## 1) Select the best module candidate (AUB autopilot)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What to expect:
- It will execute module-level experiments from `module_registry.yaml`.
- `--select-best` should promote a winner (or keep champion) based on your scoring criteria.
- If it fails to select, check the produced report/logs for “tie”, “insufficient runs”, or “regression threshold” messages.

## 2) Run system-level candidates (system autopilot)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What to expect:
- Evaluates end-to-end/system candidate configurations defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.
- If it generates a “best” config but doesn’t auto-promote, it should at least produce a ranked report you can review.

## 3) Generate the next targeted fix plan
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
What to expect:
- A prioritized “what to fix next” markdown at `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`, typically based on recent failures, bottlenecks, or biggest deltas vs champion.

---

## Quick sanity checks after running
1. Confirm whether `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` was updated or a new champion file was created.
2. Locate the latest run artifacts (often under a `runs/`, `reports/`, or timestamped directory) and verify:
   - Number of eval episodes/samples is consistent with prior comparisons.
   - No evaluation crashed/short-circuited (which can produce misleading “best”).
3. Compare the two metrics you listed:
   - `tuning_mean/min` vs `lockbox_mean/min` (watch for overfitting: tuning improves while lockbox degrades).

If you paste the stdout summary (or the generated report paths) from command (1), I can help interpret why a candidate was/wasn’t promoted and what to do next.
